project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SaaS application with role-based routing
build_system: Vite 5.4.11 with TypeScript 5.6.3, npm scripts for build/dev/typecheck
test_framework: Playwright 1.64.1 for E2E testing (npm run test if configured)
test_command: npm run typecheck (type checking only, E2E via npx playwright test)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run typecheck' to verify no TypeScript errors. 2. Run 'npm run dev' and navigate to modified screens. 3. Test animations play smoothly. 4. Verify all API data still loads (no mock data). 5. Test with prefers-reduced-motion enabled. 6. Check mobile responsive on small viewport.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. This is a pure UI enhancement task with no generated files to commit.
environment_constraints: Never restart the dev server manually. Motion v14.9.0 is already installed. All animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Preserve all existing API calls and authentication logic.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all backend API integration. Never replace real data with mock data. Maintain role-based access control. Keep all existing functionality intact. Use only GPU-accelerated CSS properties (transform, opacity) for animations. Test on both creator and manager roles.
key_patterns: Motion components in src/v2/components/motion/index.tsx use EASE constant [0.22,1,0.36,1] and useReducedMotion() hook. All views use PageTransition wrapper. Cards use AnimatedCard component. Context accessed via useApp() hook. Color palette uses warm forest green (brand-500), sage, terracotta, amber, cream. Tailwind utility classes throughout.
directory_structure: src/v2/ contains the v2 refactored app. src/v2/components/motion/index.tsx is the single source of all animation primitives. src/v2/components/views/creator/ has 10 creator screens. src/v2/components/views/manager/ has 11 manager screens. src/v2/components/layout/ contains Sidebar and layout shells. src/v2/context/AppContext.tsx provides useApp() hook with all data and actions.
